rationale: The plan matches the reference: one DESeq2 fit on all twelve samples with ~condition and control releveled as reference, an LRT against ~1 for the omnibus question, and treated_a/treated_b vs control Wald contrasts drawn from the shared dispersion with apeglm/ashr shrinkage and per-contrast BH at 0.05, explicitly forbidding per-pair subsetting and keeping LRT and contrast results as distinct objects. QC (PCA, distances, size factors, dispersion, p-value histogram) and a justified low-count filter (>=10 in at least 4 samples) precede the model, with a stated outlier policy though no explicit library-depth check. Deductions: the |log2FC|>1 cut is applied post hoc rather than via lfcThreshold, the GSEA ranking metric is left as an either/or, and MSigDB collection versions, gene-set size windows, and package versions for the report are not stated.
